name: SPECIMEN_ALL_OWNERS
description: Stores all the current, previous, and future owners for a specimen.

columns.name: SPECIMEN_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the specimen record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: CM_PHY_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this record or line. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: ALL_OWNER_PAT_ID
columns.description: Stores all the patients who are previous, current, or future owners of a given specimen (embryo, oocyte, or sperm).

columns.name: ALL_OWNER_COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments associated with the owner of the specimen.

columns.name: ALL_OWN_START_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: Stores the UTC instant the owner started their ownership over a particular specimen.

columns.name: ALL_OWN_END_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: Stores the UTC instant the owner ended their ownership over a particular specimen.

columns.name: PREV_SPEC_REI_SPEC_STATE_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the state of the specimen (in-culture, frozen, discarded, etc.) at the instant ownership changes from active to previous for a given specimen.

columns.name: PREV_SPEC_EMB_SPEC_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The type of embryology specimen (oocyte, embryo, or sperm) at the instant ownership changes from active to previous for a given specimen.

columns.name: PREV_SPEC_CULT_DAY
columns.description: Stores the latest number of culture days that have occurred for the specimen when it was received in the lab at the instant ownership changes from active to previous for a given specimen.

columns.name: PREV_EXT_RTRVL_DATE
columns.description: Stores the last documented date on which the oocyte retrieval occurred since the instant their ownership had expired.

columns.name: PREV_EXT_FREEZE_DATE
columns.description: Stores the last documented date on which the specimen was frozen since the instant their ownership had expired.

columns.name: PREV_SPEC_EXT_CMTS
columns.description: Stores the last documented comments associated with the embryology specimen that came from an external lab.

columns.name: PREV_OOCYTE_PAT_ID
columns.description: Stores the last patient record ID who was an oocyte contributor to the specimen at the end of an owner's period of ownership.

columns.name: PREV_OOCYTE_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Stores the last non-patient record ID who was an oocyte contributor to the specimen at the end of an owner's period of ownership.

columns.name: PREV_EGG_GAMETE_SOURCE_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the last type of genetic contribution of the oocyte contributor. This includes autologous, partner, anonymous donor, and directed donor.

columns.name: PREV_SPERM_PAT_ID
columns.description: Stores the last patient record ID who was a sperm contributor to the specimen at the end of an owner's period of ownership.

columns.name: PREV_SPERM_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Stores the last non-patient record ID who was a sperm contributor to the specimen at the end of an owner's period of ownership.

columns.name: PREV_SPERM_GAMETE_SOURCE_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the last type of genetic contribution of the sperm contributor. This includes autologous, partner, anonymous donor, and directed donor.
